newsitem.title: HUNGARY: NUTRICIA MAY SELL HAJDUTEJ TO FRIESLAND.
newsitem.headline: NUTRICIA MAY SELL HAJDUTEJ TO FRIESLAND.

text.p: Dutch dairy companies Nutricia and Friesland Dairy Foods (FDF) are in talks about international cooperation that would include the takeover of Nutricia's majority stake in Hungarian dairy firm Hajdutej by Friesland, Hajdutej said on Saturday.

Hajdutej was suspended on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) for Friday after a newspaper report said Friesland planned to take over Nutricia's stake, and that Hajdutej had not informed investors about the potential deal officially.

"On behalf of the director board of Hajdutej, I confirm that the Dutch N.V. Verenigde Bedrijven Nutricia and the also Dutch Friesland Dairy Foods Holding N.V. decided to examine the opportunities of the linking or transfer to each other of some of their activities," Hajdutej chairman Jeep Cheriex said in a statement in the BSE's official gazette.
Friesland and Nutricia are negotiating about cooperation in the Netherlands and Belgium, Cheriex said.

He added that they were also looking at the ways of transferring the production and marketing of certain products -- milk, butter, cheese -- to each other in Germany, the Czech Republic, Poland and Hungary.

"As a part of the transaction, FDF takes over all the shares which Nutricia International B.V. owns in Hajdutej Rt -- this is currently 79.6 percent," Cheriex said, adding that Nutricia planned to increase its stake to 96.7 percent by the end of this year.

Both parties planned to keep the production of the basic materials of Robebi and Midibe babyfoods at Hajdutej's milk powder plant in Gyula, southeast Hungary. The babyfoods are traded by Egis-Nutricia Kft, the joint venture of Nutricia and the drugs maker Egis .
Friesland would expand substantially its dairy industry activities in the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany and in several countries of Central Europe, the statement said.
It added that Hajdutej did not disclose further information because the negotiations between Friesland and Nutricia were at a very early stage.
Hajdutej closed at 900 forints on the BSE on November 14, when it was last traded.
